name: mcp-icloud
description: Apple services for Claude: Email, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, Notes, Messages and Safari, in local (AppleScript) or cloud (IMAP/CalDAV/CardDAV) mode.
long_description:
Gives Claude access to seven Apple services through a single MCP server.

LOCAL mode (the default) drives the native macOS apps with AppleScript. It needs no credentials and works offline, but requires macOS and the per-app Automation permissions the system prompts for on first use.

CLOUD mode uses the iCloud protocols (IMAP/SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV) and works from any machine, but covers only Email, Calendar and Contacts and needs an app-specific password from appleid.apple.com.

Switch between them at runtime with the set-mode tool; no restart required.

use_local_mode.title: Use local mode (macOS apps)
use_local_mode.description: On: drive the native macOS apps with AppleScript - no credentials needed, all seven services. Off: use the iCloud protocols, which work from anywhere but cover only Email, Calendar and Contacts and require the app-specific password below.

icloud_email.title: iCloud email address
icloud_email.description: Only needed for cloud mode. Your iCloud address, e.g. you@icloud.com.

app_password.title: iCloud app-specific password
app_password.description: Only needed for cloud mode. Generate one at appleid.apple.com under Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords. This is NOT your Apple ID password.
